title: Protein-DNA Clusters Explain the Non-Exponential DNA Residence Time Distributions of Transcription Factors
one_liner_zh: 该文用粗粒化分子动力学模拟研究转录因子与DNA形成多聚簇导致非指数驻留时间分布，聚焦TF-DNA动态结合机理，方法为物理模拟，高度匹配本课题。
abstract: The transcription process is regulated by temporal interactions of transcription factors with DNA. In the last decade, computational and experimental studies revealed the residence times of transcription factors on DNA correlate with transcriptional output. Biochemical studies suggest that transcription factor bindings exhibit bi-exponential dynamics, often explained by the binary affinity model composed of nonspecific and specific protein-DNA interactions. Recently, transcription factor residence times were shown to display a power law in vivo implicating effective protein-DNA interactions controlling the dissociation kinetics are rather more complex than suggested. One contribution that can cause such continuous residence-time distributions could be higher-order protein-DNA complexes or protein coacervates. Here, by using molecular dynamics simulations of a coarse-grained polymer model for bacterial chromosomes interacting with homodimeric transcription factors at physiologically relevant concentrations, we demonstrate that residence time distributions of dimeric proteins follow a multi-exponential pattern even when a single interaction describes the affinity between DNA and protein. Our simulations reveal that this emergent behavior is due to the formation of DNA-protein clusters of various sizes at a wide range of protein concentrations and affinities. These findings add another layer to transcriptional regulation and, consequently, to gene expression by connecting transcription factor concentrations and affinities, DNA-protein clusters, and DNA residence times of transcription factors.
abstract_zh: 转录过程受转录因子与DNA之间时间性相互作用的调控。在过去十年中，计算和实验研究揭示了转录因子在DNA上的停留时间与转录输出相关。生化研究表明，转录因子结合表现出双指数动力学，通常由由非特异性和特异性蛋白质-DNA相互作用组成的二元亲和模型解释。近期，转录因子停留时间在体内显示出幂律分布，暗示控制解离动力学的有效蛋白质-DNA相互作用比先前建议的更为复杂。可能导致这种连续停留时间分布的一个贡献因素可能是高阶蛋白质-DNA复合物或蛋白质凝聚体。在此，通过使用粗粒化聚合物模型的分子动力学模拟，模拟细菌染色体在生理相关浓度下与同型二聚体转录因子的相互作用，我们证明即使单一相互作用描述了DNA与蛋白质之间的亲和力，二聚体蛋白的停留时间分布也遵循多指数模式。我们的模拟揭示，这种涌现行为源于在广泛的蛋白质浓度和亲和力范围内形成各种大小的DNA-蛋白质簇。这些发现通过连接转录因子浓度和亲和力、DNA-蛋白质簇以及转录因子的DNA停留时间，为转录调控及由此的基因表达增添了另一层复杂性。
